question: Who among the following is the brand ambassador of Equitas Small Finance Bank (ESFB)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Smriti Mandhana**__ is an Indian women's cricketer.

 __
 
• She was voted the** Best Women's International Cricketer **by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in June 2018.
 
• **Smriti Mandhana is the brand ambassador of Equitas Small Finance Bank (ESFB)**__.
 __
 
• Equitas Small Finance Bank has named Rani Rampal, a women's hockey player, and Smriti Mandhana, a cricketer, as brand ambassadors.
 
• This announcement coincides with the bank's 5th anniversary, which will take place on September 5, 2021.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virat Kohli **was appointed as the brand ambassador of Fire-Boltt in 2021.
 
• **Rohit Sharma** is the first non-footballer to become the brand ambassador of La Liga in India.
 
• **Mithali Raj **is the brand ambassador for L’oreal Paris.
